name: sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-monorepo
description: AI-powered image generation for Sanity Studio using Google Gemini

scripts.build: npm run build -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-contracts && npm run build -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-engine && npm run build -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-nextjs -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-serverless
scripts.type-check: npm run build -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-contracts && npm run build -w sanity-plugin-gemini-ai-images-engine && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
